options.text: Add still more decoration to fill all the empty areas
options.misconception: reverses the advice by adding visual noise

options.text: Remove the irrelevant elements so the information stands out
Hide all of the information from the user entirely
options.misconception: confuses minimalism with a complete absence of content

options.text: Use the smallest possible text size everywhere on the screen
options.misconception: mistakes a reduction in size for a gain in clarity

questions.explanation: A minimalist design keeps only what serves the purpose, so relevant information is not buried in decoration. Stripping away unrelated elements reduces distraction and helps users concentrate on the task at hand.
questions.hint: Does every single visible element truly need to be there?
